title: OPL Cloud versioned owner events
description: 严格事件payload，无密码/Key/credentials/private endpoints。int64在JSON以string编码。Outbox事务提交→gRPC Inbox事务去重ACK。

x-delivery.outboxAtomicity: owner mutation + outbox row in same PostgreSQL transaction
x-delivery.inboxAtomicity: unique authenticated producer/eventId per target consumer + complete immutable envelope equality + consumer mutation + emitted events in one Owner transaction before committed ACK; a pending receipt is not an applied ACK
x-delivery.ordering: Gaps are legitimate for partial subscriptions. Immutable facts deduplicate eventId+business identity. Mutable projections monotonic-CAS aggregateVersion, no stale overwrite. Dependent effects check explicit predecessor facts/receipts; missing facts remain unprocessed, never infer loss from a version gap. ACK duplicates without reapply.
x-delivery.unknown: external timeout records unknown and schedules readback; never repeats financial/provider action blindly
x-delivery.retention: retain deduplication for original obligation lifetime; no short TTL for financial events
x-delivery.schemaEvolution: eventType includes version, immutable payload schema; unknown version rejects and needs_attention; no permissive map

outboxFieldMap.scope: tenant_id NULL means platform, otherwise tenant
outboxFieldMap.aggregateId: outbox_events.aggregate_id; equals required payload field named by x-aggregate-identity.idPayloadField
outboxFieldMap.aggregateVersion: outbox_events.aggregate_revision; positive Owner-local aggregate sequence allocated under the aggregate lock
outboxFieldMap.aggregateType: exact (eventType,schemaVersion) -> x-aggregate-identity.type -> outbox_events.aggregate_type; derived, not an extra wire field

x-delivery.registrationFlow: build.artifact_confirmed.v1 → Capability Inbox reads BuildCoordination.ReadArtifact including exact DeploymentDescriptor/claim inputs → atomic Capability ready+outbox → capability.version_registered.v1 → Build succeeded; no direct second registration writer
x-delivery.aggregateIdentity: For each exact (eventType,schemaVersion), x-aggregate-identity.type is the only aggregate_type; aggregateId equals its required idPayloadField byte-for-byte. Reject unknown pairs or mismatches; do not infer from a name prefix or freely supplied type. Producer allocates positive aggregateVersion under the owning aggregate lock in its state+outbox transaction; retry preserves eventId/type/id/version/payload. A domain-specific generation, permissionVersion, or timestamp is not a generic aggregate revision.
x-delivery.consumerAddressing: DeliverEventRequest.consumer_owner selects one subscribed logical Owner per call; tenant and gateway share one process but have separate databases, Inbox transactions, and ACKs. Reject UNSPECIFIED, unknown, unserved, unsubscribed or peer-mismatched producer; never infer consumer from payload or service address.
